name: artifact-use
description: Publish and manage gated, tenant-scoped artifacts through Artifact Use without Cloudflare credentials.

interface.longDescription: Artifact Use lets Codex publish single-file or folder artifacts to a hosted Cloudflare-backed service through MCP/CLI using WorkOS OAuth tokens, with tenant-prefixed URLs, viewer gates, stats, and share links.
interface.defaultPrompt: Publish this artifact with Artifact Use.
